summary: Improve donor reports with traceable MEAL evidence, clear narratives and practical follow-up tools. Explore this five-day humanitarian course.
lede: Training in humanitarian project reporting and donor relations helps programme, MEAL and grants professionals turn project evidence into accurate donor updates. Participants practise tracing logframe indicators to source records, validating evidence and explaining results, constraints and corrective actions. They also develop reporting calendars, issue briefings and documented follow-up to coordinate submissions and donor commitments.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals who prepare humanitarian project reports, coordinate grants or communicate programme progress to institutional donors and partner agencies.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with humanitarian project implementation and basic MEAL or logframe terminology is expected. No coding or programming is required.
